search_home_lead: Lodestar finds torrents on the network by itself and lets you search them. Type a few words in the box above, or try one of these:
search_home_health_working: Lodestar is working and finding new torrents.
search_home_health_ready: Lodestar is ready and waiting for new torrents.
search_home_health_paused: The crawler is paused. Open Insights to resume it.
search_home_health_restart: A change needs a restart. Open Settings.
search_home_health_attention: Something needs attention. Open Insights to see what.
